transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess I’m here because I can’t really shut my mind off. It keeps jumping between work stuff, like whether this new lab partnership means my position might get cut, or if my data’s wrong… then bills, my family thinking I’m falling behind, grad school chances. It’s just a lot, and it doesn’t really let up.
Are there things you used to do or places you used to go that you're avoiding now because of these thoughts?
I’m not sure. I don’t think there’s a specific place I’ve stopped going to because of it. I mean, I might put things off sometimes, but… I haven’t really thought of it as avoiding places.
Are there any activities you've stopped doing because of these thoughts?

Yeah… I guess so. I haven’t really been keeping up with things. I missed an internal lab deadline because I just couldn’t get my writing and data review organized.

And outside work, stuff like reports, going to art nights, even cooking for my family… it all feels like too much lately.
Do you often feel nervous or on edge?

Yeah… pretty often. At work especially I feel kind of wound up, like I can’t just sit still. I’ll tap my foot or keep checking messages, or I’ll get up and walk back to the instrument room even when I don’t really need to. Even normal lab noises can make me jump sometimes.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time?
I don’t know… not most of the time, I don’t think. I’ve felt off, but I wouldn’t really call it sad or empty.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?
I’m not sure. Maybe a little, but it’s hard to tell… I still like those things, I just haven’t really felt up to doing much.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?
Not that I’ve really noticed. I don’t weigh myself much, but my clothes seem about the same.
Do you have thoughts that keep repeating in your mind and are difficult to control?

Yeah… kind of. I’ll try to just focus on one thing, like a report or checking an assay, and then one worry turns into another. After a while I’m just staring at the screen, going through all the ways something could go wrong.
Are you avoiding certain social situations because of these thoughts?
I don’t know… not specifically. I mean, I might keep to myself sometimes, but I’m not sure it’s because of those thoughts exactly.
Do you have thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted?

Yeah… I guess unwanted, yeah. I try to make myself focus on one thing, like finishing a report or checking an assay, and then one worry just sets off another. Before I know it I’m just staring at the screen, running through all the ways things could go wrong.
Have your worries and thoughts been affecting your relationships with family or friends?

Yeah… a bit. I’ve been kind of dropping the ball. I missed an internal lab deadline because I couldn’t get my writing and data review organized, and then outside work… even just showing up for art nights or cooking for my family feels like too much to keep up with lately.
Do you feel like you have to repeat certain actions or behaviors over and over?
Not really… I mean, I might check something again if I’m unsure, but I don’t think I have to repeat things over and over like that.
Do you have thoughts that are intrusive or unwanted and involve fears of contamination, harm, or danger?
Um… not really in that way, I don’t think. It’s more just worries piling up, not like specific contamination or danger thoughts.
Do you feel a strong need to perform tasks in a specific, orderly way?
I don’t think so. I mean, I like things to be organized, but I don’t feel like I have to do tasks in some exact order or anything.
Have you felt like your worries and thoughts are significantly interfering with your daily life or ability to function?

Yeah… I think it is. I missed an internal lab deadline because I just couldn’t get my writing and data review organized. And lately even normal stuff—reports, showing up to art nights, cooking for my family—feels like… more than I can keep up with.
Have you experienced a significant stressful event or change in your life recently that might be triggering these worries and thoughts?
Yeah… I guess so. It started around seven months ago, when the lab’s funding shifted and that commercial partnership changed how everything was being run. Since then it’s just been… a lot.
Do you have recurring thoughts that are disturbing or inappropriate and that you try to ignore or suppress?
I don’t think so. I mean… I get stuck worrying, but not really disturbing or inappropriate thoughts that I’m trying to push away.
Have these worries and thoughts been present continuously since the lab's funding shifted seven months ago?
Yeah… pretty much. It’s been about seven months, since that funding shift and the partnership changes happened. It hasn’t really let up.
Have you experienced these worries and thoughts for less than 6 months after the stressful event, or have they lasted longer than that?
Longer than that… about seven months now, since the funding shift and the partnership changes at the lab.
Have you experienced significant distress or impairment due to these worries and thoughts for most days since they started seven months ago?

Yeah… most days, I think. It’s gotten in the way. I missed an internal lab deadline because I just couldn’t get my writing and data review organized, and even normal things—reports, art nights, cooking for my family—feel like too much to keep up with.
